task.description: Produce the design artefact (lib/letflow/design/req192-service-catalog-routes.md or similar) for a new lib/letflow/routers/services.ex router exposing: GET /api/v1/services (tenant-scoped list: global + caller's own tenant-scoped entries, cursor-paginated, :ServicesRead), GET /api/v1/admin/services (ALL entries regardless of scope/owner, :AdminServicesRead), POST /api/v1/admin/services (register, :AdminServicesManage, 201 + created record), PATCH /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id (update scope, :AdminServicesManage), DELETE /api/v1/admin/services/:service_id (:AdminServicesManage). Map REQ-191's real context-module error tuples to HTTP: the two referential-guard conflicts (delete blocked by referencing ACTIVE definitions; global-to-tenant narrowing blocked by other tenants' ACTIVE definitions) and a duplicate service_id on register all become 409 with a problem-details body naming the conflicting ids, per REQ-066's convention. A tenant-scoped service belonging to another tenant on the non-admin GET path returns 404, never 403 (REQ-072). ServiceRecord JSON serialization must match web/src/types/api.ts field-for-field. Do NOT modify lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex, lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex, or anything under web/ -- consume the existing policy keys and context module as-is; if a mapping looks wrong, name it as a finding in the design, don't silently fix it there. Design only -- no fenced code blocks reproducing real .ex content (this project's mechanical no-exceptions rule, hit repeatedly in this pipeline including on the two immediately preceding requirements' designs).
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/services returns global entries plus the calling tenant's own scoped entries, and a tenant-scoped entry owned by a different tenant is absent from the response -- asserted with entries of all three kinds present in the database

GET /api/v1/admin/services returns entries the caller's own tenant does not own, demonstrating it is not tenant-filtered, and requires :AdminServicesRead -- a caller holding only :ServicesRead receives 403
POST /api/v1/admin/services with a RegisterServiceBody creates the entry and returns 201 with a body whose field names match web/src/api/services.ts's ServiceRecord exactly, asserted field by field

POST, PATCH and DELETE under /api/v1/admin/services each return 403 for a caller lacking :AdminServicesManage, using the mapping already present in lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex -- three explicit tests

DELETE of a service referenced by an ACTIVE definition returns 409 whose problem-details body lists the referencing definition ids; PATCH narrowing a service other tenants' ACTIVE definitions reference returns 409 listing those tenant ids -- two explicit tests
POST with an already-registered service_id returns 409 and does not modify the existing entry
a request naming a tenant-scoped service belonging to another tenant on the non-admin path returns 404, never 403 (REQ-072's cross-tenant rule)
lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex is NOT modified by this requirement, confirmed by git diff --stat scoped to its commits -- the SVC-04 policy keys it already ships are consumed as-is
no file under web/ is added or modified, confirmed by git diff --stat -- the SPA client already exists and S8 owns it
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted
